name: My Two First Loves
source:
A high school senior finds herself torn between her Boy Next Door childhood friend and the misunderstood local bad boy... and possibly someone else as well.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/MyTwoFirstLoves]TV tropes[/url]]
translation:
一名高三女生发现自己在邻家大男孩般的青梅竹马与被人误解的当地坏小子之间左右为难……甚至可能还有其他人的介入。

[引自[url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/MyTwoFirstLoves]TV tropes[/url]]
